rows.en: I see... So there's still hope.
Well, what do ya know... So there's still hope after all!
I see... So there's still hope.
I see... Then there's still hope.
I see... So there's still hope.
I see... So there's still hope.
Most likely, Taro protected that last flame... even if it meant sacrificing himself.
That's entirely possible, knowing him.
All right, everyone. Let's rescue Taro.
Of course!! The more allies we have, the better.
Belial said Taro's frozen solid deep inside the Plasma Spark Tower...
Don't worry. I've prepared a way to rescue him.
Take this with you. You'll need it to save Taro.
Obtained the "Magnerium Medicalizer".
What's this...?
It's the "Magnerium Medicalizer".
It's the Magnerium Ray that once saved Brother Seven, made into a Meteor cartridge.
Good. Take this and head for the Plasma Spark Tower.
...!! Wait a moment! An Ultra Sign is coming in!
An Ultra Sign is coming in.
"Assemble at the Colosseum"...? What does that mean?
What does that mean?
Isn't this the "game" Belial was talking about?
Forget about that! Let's hurry up and rescue Ultraman Taros already!
Sempai, it's not Taros, it's Taro!
Huh? It ain't?
But to reach the Plasma Spark Tower, we have to pass through the Colosseum either way.
Isn't there another route?
...As I told you before, the layout inside the Cube differs from the real Land of Light.
The only route I've seen with my own eyes is the one that goes through the Colosseum.
It can't be helped. Let's head to the Colosseum for now.
But a "game"... What is the enemy plotting...?
Brother Zoffy, Ace and I will try entering that game.
Oh, you'll do it...!
Yes. We may be able to learn what the enemy has up their sleeve.
...You'd feel a little uneasy with just the two of you, wouldn't you?
I'll join too.
Accel...!
Whoa, if that's how it is, mind if I join in too?
Birth too!
Very well. Jack, Ace, Accel, Birth: I want the four of you to enter that game as a team.
Roger!
{8074}, I want you and the others to head for the Plasma Spark Tower.
But if you can't secure a way to the tower, {8074}, you all join the game too...
...and scout out the enemy!
{8074} and the team rescued Black RX and headed for the base.
Apart from 00, Wing Zero and Seravee, the members of Celestial Being
stayed inside the Cube to continue the operation to take its unsecured areas.
As soon as they arrived at the base, Black RX was carried straight to the medical room.
So this is your base...
This place seems to exist independently of the other Cubes.
That's about the size of it.
And every facility that got absorbed into it is something useful to us...
Why on earth would that be...?
I'm investigating the base as we explore the Cubes... We should solve the mystery eventually.
We should get to the bottom of the mystery sooner or later.
By the way, did you learn anything from striking their headquarters?
...I see. That's certainly worrying. Arche Gundam's last words...
Whoever he meant by "higher-ups," it apparently isn't The O...
So there's a mastermind in another Cube, after all?
That's the natural conclusion.
Everyone...!!
RX!! Are you all right now!?
Yeah, I can move well enough now.
I can't just lie around in bed until we've saved Rider 1 and Rider 2.
Don't push yourself too hard.
If I remember right, Rider 1 and Rider 2 were taken to the "Hideout Cube," weren't they?
The Cube where they concentrate on experiments and modification... wasn't it?
Yeah. The enemy said something like they'd "re-modify" them...
...That settles it.
But hey, how do we even get to that Cube?
We should be able to find it by exploring the Ride Dungeon.
But it's walls everywhere in there. I don't remember anywhere we could even explore...
Heh...
What?
I had a feeling something like this might come up...
So I fitted the Ride Machine with the "Pelucidar Drill" you all brought back.
